band_heading: Flexible support for workloads that rarely follow a straight line.
band_intro: From an individual matter to ongoing practice capacity, the arrangement should reflect the work—not the other way around.
title: Support structured around your practice.
model_1_body: Defined deliverables for individual matters or specific accounting workloads, with scope and fees agreed before work begins.
model_2_body: Ongoing support aligned with your workflows, reporting expectations and agreed availability as appointment volumes evolve.
model_3_body: Direct technical casework support from Kapil Kumar, CPA Australia, subject to availability and agreed engagement terms.
closing_note: All arrangements are independent firm-to-firm engagements. Scope, fees, turnaround times and review responsibilities are agreed before commencement.
